notes.title: About LAPSO development
notes.content:
[[b]EN[/b]]
Dear players

Some time ago we told you that we were looking for a publisher to bring [i][b]LAPSO[/b][/i] to completion with the quality we thought the project deserved. We are a 2 people indie team and by ourselves we couldn't afford the cost of creating projects of more than 1 year of development and adding other members to the team. For this reason, since June last year we have been pitching the game to different publishers and, although we have had meetings with several of them, we haven't reached an agreement with any of them to develop the game we want yet. 

We thank you very much for your support all this time. For us this is not just any project, it's a very personal one, and we will keep looking for a way to make it possible.  In the meantime we have been developing other projects that are more manageable for us and we will show them to you soon.  We hope you like them as much as we do. 

Thanks for playing! ☺

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36211653/2a9e23469b2c3ec69d99830820275dc759576fc7.jpg[/img]

[[b]ES[/b]]
Queridos jugadores

Hace un tiempo os avisamos de que estábamos buscando publisher para poder llevar a término [i][b]LAPSO[/b][/i] con la calidad que creíamos que se merecía el proyecto. Somos un equipo indie de 2 personas y por nosotros mismos no podíamos asumir el coste de crear proyectos de más de 1 año de desarrollo y añadiendo otros miembros al equipo. Por esta razón, desde Junio del año pasado hemos estado pitcheando el juego a diferentes editores y, aunque hemos tenido reuniones con varios de ellos, no hemos terminado de llegar a un acuerdo con ninguno para desarrollar el juego que queremos aún. 

Os agradecemos muchísimo el apoyo todo este tiempo. Para nosotros este no es un proyecto cualquiera, es uno muy personal, y seguiremos buscando la forma de hacerlo posible.  Mientras tanto hemos estado desarrollando otros proyectos más abarcables para nosotros que os mostraremos pronto.  Ojalá que os gusten tanto como a nosotros. 

¡Gracias por jugar! ☺

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36211653/eb7a0c3924e65826d85b8ecdd8c4911055037037.png[/img]

notes.title: Lapso: NIMBO is out!
notes.content:
[b]Lapso: NIMBO is now available![/b]

We apologize for the delay, we are only two people in the team and we have had many last minute problems that have complicated the launch. But it is out now and we have worked hard to add many stuff that were not in the previous version, including achievements.

We hope you enjoy it!
Greetings!
